interest: A useful live-quiz service and visible innovation
expectation: The sponsor expects a working MVP demonstration in week 7 and a pilot with 50 students in week 14 within the $200 cash cap.

interest: A manageable, assessable project with timely decisions
expectation: The PM expects the sponsor to confirm scope and success criteria, attend the week-7 and week-13 gates, and respond to change requests within five working days.

interest: Clear priorities, feedback, and a deliverable project
expectation: The team expects approved requirements, timely reviews, and access to test and deployment environments.

interest: Fair, fast quizzes and clear feedback
expectation: Pilot students expect to join with a code, answer timed questions, and see their own score and the leaderboard during the week-14 pilot.

interest: Easy quiz authoring and useful results
expectation: Lecturers expect to create multiple-choice quizzes, host sessions, and review or export results where the feature is delivered.

interest: A supportable service with no surprise handover
expectation: IT operations expects a deployment checklist, runbook, restart and recovery steps, and backup instructions at least two weeks before the pilot.

interest: WebSocket traffic works within campus network rules
expectation: The network administrator expects an early connectivity test and a documented fallback if the campus proxy blocks WebSocket traffic.

interest: The project meets course outcomes and assessment needs
expectation: The capstone owner expects progress evidence, a clear scope baseline, and a demonstrable MVP in week 7.

interest: Student data is minimised, protected, and retained appropriately
expectation: The data protection stakeholder expects a one-page data description and proposed retention/access rules before the pilot and may block use of real student data until approval.

interest: Evidence that the tool is useful and supportable
expectation: Faculty management expects a short pilot report with feedback, limitations, operating needs, and a recommendation about next-semester adoption.

name_or_group: SaaS quiz vendor (only if option B is selected)
interest: A clear subscription and support arrangement
expectation: If the sponsor switches to option B, the vendor is expected to provide written education pricing, data terms, availability information, and support details before purchase.
